Definition: from G1378; to prescribe by statute, i.e. (reflexively) to submit to, ceremonially rule:--be subject to ordinances.
BiblicalUsage: To be subject to ordinances, as Paul asks why believers submit to rules like touch not and taste not, as though they still lived in the world. The word stands in the Greek text in its middle voice, as a submitting of oneself to man-made decrees.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Christ's death freed me from man-made ordinances, and I will not let a rulebook take the place of the risen Lord.
